lines.text: Can brake fluid free a rusted bolt better than the stuff that's made for it?
ai: a heavily rusted bolt and nut glistening with a drop of golden oil

lines.text: He rusts a pile of bolts on purpose and drips six fluids on them.
ai: a pile of bright orange rusted bolts on a wooden workbench
six small bottles of different coloured oils in a row

lines.text: The trick is capillary action which pulls a thin liquid into tiny gaps like a paper towel drinking a spill.
ai: macro of thin golden oil creeping up into tiny cracks of rusty metal
a white paper towel soaking up a spilled blue drink
macro of a liquid droplet disappearing into a hairline crack

lines.text: The brake fluid just sits on the washer like it gave up.
ai: a single drop of fluid sitting on a rusty washer like a bead

lines.text: But when he cuts the bolt open it crept all the way to the bottom.
ai: a steel bolt sliced in half lengthwise showing oil inside the threads macro

lines.text: Fluid Film coats everything like slime but it's too thick to squeeze into the threads.
ai: thick green slime coating a rusty bolt macro
thick honey failing to enter a narrow crack macro

lines.text: Then viewers beg him to mix them all into one super oil which is risky because chemicals can react.
ai: six different coloured oils swirling together in a glass beaker
two chemicals reacting with smoke in a glass flask

lines.text: And the mix never crept down so a nut that was only hand tight needed 56 foot pounds.
ai: a wrench straining on a stuck rusty nut with motion blur

lines.text: The winner is Seafoam Deep Creep with CRC Knocker Loose right behind it.
ai: a golden trophy on a podium in a garage spotlight
a silver trophy next to a gold trophy under spotlights

lines.text: Because in rusty threads the gaps are microscopic so only the thinnest fluid gets in.
ai: extreme macro of microscopic gaps inside rusty bolt threads
a thin liquid racing a thick syrup down a crack macro
macro of oil flowing into a rusted thread

lines.text: So would you trust brake fluid on your next rusted bolt?
ai: a heavily rusted bolt and nut glistening with a drop of golden oil
